items.title: 美超微狂飆19% AI基礎建設股全面上漲
items.title_en: Supermicro Soars 19% as AI Infrastructure Stocks Rally Across the Board
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，AI基礎建設類股周三(12日)全面上漲，此前AI伺服器硬體製造商美超微電腦(Supermicro)(SMCI-US)及新興雲端服務商CoreWeave(CRWV-US)與Nebius(NBIS-US)公布亮眼財報。AI託管業者Applied Digital(APLD-US)與IREN(IREN-US)股價也走高。
美超微與CoreWeave周三大漲超過19%，Nebius更暴漲逾34%。
AI基礎建設交易的其他領域同樣上漲，包括光學產品製造商Lumentum(LITE-US)。記憶體及儲存類股也走強，Roundhill Memory ETF(DRAM-US)同步上漲。
從運算能力、AI伺服器機櫃到液冷技術，各項AI基礎建設的需求都顯示正在加速，隨著相關企業陸續公布財報，整個AI基礎建設產業因此全面走高。
Nebius股價飆升，此前公司公布的季營收高於分析師預期。美超微公布第四季財報，獲利遠超分析師預期，財測也樂觀。
新興雲端服務商及AI託管業者Applied Digital與IREN股價走高，因AI雲端服務商CoreWeave財報顯示需求正在加速，積壓訂單也大幅增加。
Lumentum股價上漲逾13%。這家為資料中心提供光學及光電產品的製造商公布第四季營收達10.1億美元，較去年同期增加超過一倍。同業Coherent(COHR-US)及Ciena(CIEN-US)股價也雙雙大漲。
記憶體及儲存類股同樣走高，Roundhill Memory ETF大漲7.6%，近期漲勢強勁的SanDisk(SNDK-US)則上漲5.7%。
記憶體製造商美光(MU-US)漲近5%，競爭對手SK海力士(SKHY-US)飆升9%。
隨著企業陸續採用AI，投資人一直在押注所謂的「賣鏟子」交易，也就是投資那些提供AI技術所需基礎建設的企業，而相關公司目前也持續預期市場需求強勁。
Fundstrat周三指出，在截至目前已公布財報的標普500指數企業中，87%的公司獲利優於預期，而這些「優於預期」的企業，其實際表現中位數比市場預期高出7%。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that AI infrastructure stocks rose across the board on Wednesday (the 12th) after AI server hardware maker Supermicro (SMCI-US) and emerging cloud service provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) along with Nebius (NBIS-US) posted impressive earnings. AI hosting firms Applied Digital (APLD-US) and IREN (IREN-US) also saw their shares climb.
Supermicro and CoreWeave surged more than 19% on Wednesday, while Nebius rocketed over 34%.

Other segments of AI infrastructure trading also rose, including optical‑product maker Lumentum (LITE-US). Memory and storage stocks were strong as well, with the Roundhill Memory ETF (DRAM-US) moving higher in tandem.

Demand for all facets of AI infrastructure—from compute power and AI server racks to liquid‑cooling technology—is accelerating, and as related companies continue to release earnings, the entire AI infrastructure sector is moving higher.
Nebius’s stock spiked after the company reported quarterly revenue that beat analysts’ expectations. Supermicro’s fourth‑quarter results came in far above forecasts, prompting an upbeat outlook.
Emerging cloud service and AI hosting firms Applied Digital and IREN saw their shares rise as CoreWeave’s earnings showed accelerating demand and a sharp increase in back‑logged orders.

Lumentum’s stock jumped more than 13%. The data‑center optical and photonic product maker reported fourth‑quarter revenue of $1.01 billion, more than double the same period last year. Peers Coherent (COHR-US) and Ciena (CIEN-US) also posted strong gains.
Memory and storage stocks also climbed, with the Roundhill Memory ETF up 7.6% and the recently strong‑performing SanDisk (SNDK-US) gaining 5.7%.
Memory chipmaker Micron (MU-US) rose nearly 5%, while rival SK Hynix (SKHY-US) surged 9%.

As enterprises increasingly adopt AI, investors have been betting on the so‑called “shovel‑seller” trade—investing in companies that provide the infrastructure needed for AI technologies—and those firms continue to expect robust market demand.

Fundstrat noted on Wednesday that among S&P 500 companies that have reported earnings to date, 87% posted profits that beat expectations, and the median actual performance of these “beat‑the‑estimate” firms was 7% above market forecasts.

items.title: 聯準會9月升不升息？債市仍押「五五波」 緊盯兩大關鍵數據
items.title_en: Will the Fed Raise Rates in September? Bond Market Still Bets on a “50‑50” Move, Watching Two Key Data Points
paras: 儘管美國通膨數據溫和，交易員仍維持對聯準會（Fed）可能在9月下次會議升息的避險部位，目前市場定價顯示，9月升息機率約為50%。
美國消費者物價指數（CPI）符合預期，帶動美國公債週三(12日)延續漲勢。對Fed政策變化最敏感的2年期美債殖利率下跌3個基點至4.18%；指標10年期美債殖利率同樣下滑3個基點至4.65%。市場並等待當天稍晚登場、規模420億美元的10年期美債標售。
利率交換市場顯示，在經濟數據公布後，交易員將10月升息機率由前一天約75%下調至約60%，而市場已完全反映Fed將在12月採取下一步行動的預期。
Aviva Investors資深固定收益投資組合經理Steve Ryder表示：「這份數據應能讓市場繼續保留9月升息的可能性，但也沒有讓Fed立即採取行動的迫切性。」
他指出，決策官員在決定今年稍晚是否需要進一步緊縮政策前，可能會更加重視下一份CPI與就業市場報告。
根據美國勞工統計局（BLS）數據，7月剔除波動較大的食品與能源項目後，核心CPI月增0.2%；年增率則為2.5%，創下自2021年3月以來的最慢增長步調。
這份通膨數據出爐前，上週公布的7月就業市場數據已低於預期。由於Fed下一次利率決策會議要到9月才舉行，市場焦點將轉向下一輪8月通膨與就業報告。
在此期間，債券投資人也將密切關注於懷俄明州傑克森霍爾（Jackson Hole）舉行的年度全球央行年會。
Natixis North America美國首席經濟學家Christopher Hodge表示，未來幾次Fed會議都必須納入意外升息的可能性，但該行仍認為，隨著通膨緩慢且逐步朝目標回落、消費部門降溫，加上就業前景更加脆弱，Fed最終仍可能驚險避免升息。
paras_en: Despite moderate U.S. inflation data, traders are still holding hedge positions for a possible Fed rate hike at the September meeting, with market pricing indicating roughly a 50% probability of a September hike.

The U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) came in line with expectations, pushing U.S. Treasury bonds higher on Wednesday (the 12th). The 2‑year Treasury yield, most sensitive to Fed policy changes, fell 3 basis points to 4.18%, while the benchmark 10‑year yield also slipped 3 basis points to 4.65%. The market is awaiting a later‑in‑the‑day $42 billion 10‑year Treasury auction.

The interest‑rate swap market showed that after the economic data release, traders cut the probability of a October hike from about 75% the day before to roughly 60%, and the market has fully priced in expectations that the Fed will take its next step in December.

Aviva Investors senior fixed‑income portfolio manager Steve Ryder said: “This data should allow the market to keep the possibility of a September hike alive, but it does not create an urgent need for the Fed to act immediately.”
He added that policymakers, before deciding whether further tightening is needed later this year, are likely to place even greater emphasis on the next CPI reading and the employment report.

According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, core CPI – which strips out the more volatile food and energy components – rose 0.2% month‑over‑month in July and 2.5% year‑over‑year, the slowest pace since March 2021.

Before this inflation data was released, last week’s July employment figures had already come in below expectations. Because the Fed’s next rate‑policy meeting isn’t until September, market focus will shift to the upcoming August inflation and jobs reports.
During that interim, bond investors will also be closely watching the annual global central‑bank gathering in Jackson Hole, Wyoming.

Natixis North America chief economist Christopher Hodge said that future Fed meetings must factor in the possibility of an unexpected rate hike, but the firm still believes that as inflation eases slowly toward target, consumer demand cools, and the employment outlook weakens, the Fed may ultimately manage to avoid another hike altogether.

items.title: AI資本支出明年衝1.6兆美元 操盤手：這波更像1998年動盪、而非網路泡沫
paras: 普信（T. Rowe Price）全球科技股票基金經理人 Dom Rizzo 預估，2027 年超大規模雲端業者資本支出上看 1.6 兆美元，遠高於市場較積極的預測。他認為，當前 AI 榮景雖讓人聯想到網路泡沫，但更像 1998 年的市場震盪，而非隨後的網路泡沫破裂，關鍵差異就在半導體基本面與資本支出仍強勁。
當 1998 至 2002 年的網路泡沫從繁榮走向破滅時，Rizzo 當時只有 5 歲。不過，身為長期研究市場泡沫與經濟週期的投資人，他對於當年網路泡沫與當前人工智慧（AI）熱潮之間的比較，有自己的一套看法。
Rizzo 在週二播出的《Excess Returns》Podcast 訪談中指出，當前市場與 1998 年的相似之處令人驚訝。
當年長期資本管理公司（LTCM）瀕臨倒閉引發市場危機，如今則可對照上月 Situational Awareness 爆倉事件；此外，高成交量、高動能交易因子造成市場日內及月度劇烈波動的情況，也十分類似。1998 年市場一度回撤 40%，今年 7 月費城半導體指數(SOX) 也曾回檔 22%，幅度雖較小，但同樣相當劇烈。
基本面大不同：半導體營收估暴增64%
然而，Rizzo 認為，兩個時期最根本的差異，恰恰在於基本面。
1998 年半導體產業營收下滑 8%，主要受到產品價格下跌拖累；但到了 2026 年，根據他掌握的產業預估，半導體業營收增幅可能高達約 64%。
這一次，Rizzo 認為企業其實只走到資本支出週期的一半，而且即將迎來新一波加速，這可能出乎部分市場人士意料。
在 2026 年資本支出大增 75% 後，他預估 2027 年超大規模雲端服務商（hyperscalers）的資本支出可能達到 1.5 兆至 1.6 兆美元，明顯高於目前市場上較積極的預測，例如美銀分析師 Vivek Arya 預估的 1.2 兆美元。
Rizzo 認為，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與微軟(MSFT-US) 在內的超大規模雲端業者，有充分誘因將投資支出極大化，原因在於投入資本報酬率相當具有吸引力。
儘管不少 AI 懷疑論者擔心如此龐大的資本支出究竟何時才能回本，但 Rizzo 援引亞馬遜 7 月公布的財測及財報電話會議內容指出，公司高層已說明預期的投資報酬。Rizzo將其概括為：「兩到三年回本，接著再享有兩到三年的強勁現金流。」
在 Rizzo 看來，超大規模雲端業者的資本支出並未觸頂反轉，而是「正處於轉折點」。
對 Rizzo 而言，整場 AI 資本支出獲利能力的爭論，關鍵其實在於一個核心問題：「晶片生態系會如何發展？超大規模雲端業者的生態系會怎麼變？應用軟體、基礎設施又會如何演進？所有問題最終都取決於一件事：幾年後，前沿 AI 實驗室會變成什麼樣子？」
Rizzo 預期未來將出現他所謂的「80比20法則世界」，其中企業所使用的AI代幣（tokens）有80%屬於開源權重（open weight）或開源軟體，20%則屬於如Anthropic或OpenAI等前沿模型。
如果 Rizzo 的預測成真，對 Workday(WDAY-US) 、Salesforce(CRM-US) 等傳統軟體即服務（SaaS）巨頭而言，可能構成威脅，因為這些公司可能遭到去中介化，甚至淪為單純的「資料管線」。
晶片股仍是主角 資金疑慮被誇大
不過，從AI資本支出的趨勢來看，短期內「晶片股仍將領漲」。晶片生態系中的多數領域，從設計、設備到生產，都可望受惠於強勁的報價，其中邏輯半導體更是瑞佐目前眼光所及最具吸引力的亮點，涵蓋台積電(2330-TW) 、三星電子(KR005930) 與英特爾(INTC-US) 等製造大廠。
Rizzo給予投資人的最後一劑定心丸是：市場對融通所有這些資本支出的擔憂實在過度了。
他分析指出，市場對資金來源的擔憂被誇大了，超大規模雲端業者所需資金與其自有資本之間的缺口，其實並沒有那麼大。
Rizzo表示，儘管絕對數字聽起來十分龐大，但相較於其債務現金流比率而言，其實並不算什麼。

items.title: iPhone 20 Pro傳螢幕再放大 以四曲面玻璃打造「無邊框」視覺
items.title_en: iPhone 20 Pro's Screen May Be Enlarged with a 'Borderless' Visual Effect Using Four-Curved Glass
paras: 蘋果傳為iPhone問世20週年籌備全新設計，預計iPhone 20 Pro系列可能維持既有螢幕長寬比例，同時放大顯示面積，並透過特殊曲面玻璃營造近乎「無邊框」的視覺效果。
微博爆料者「數碼閒聊站」週三表示，代號V73與V74的iPhone 20 Pro及iPhone 20 Pro Max，螢幕尺寸都將比前代稍大，但長寬比例不會明顯改變。
根據先前說法，蘋果 (AAPL-US)正在測試6.4吋與7吋兩種螢幕，分別用於iPhone 20 Pro和iPhone 20 Pro Max。相較之下，iPhone 17 Pro與Pro Max的螢幕尺寸分別為6.3吋及6.9吋，意味新機可能各增加0.1吋。
這套設計並非直接採用彎曲顯示面板。爆料指出，iPhone 20 Pro系列可能保留平面螢幕，再於外層覆蓋經過特殊塑形的四曲面玻璃，利用光學折射弱化螢幕邊界，形成四周幾乎看不見邊框的效果。
換言之，傳聞所稱的「無邊框」主要是由玻璃造型與光線折射營造的視覺效果，並不一定代表實體邊框完全消失。
類似消息先前已多次流出。「數碼閒聊站」7月便曾提到iPhone 20 Pro系列可能採用6.4吋及7吋螢幕，4月也曾透露蘋果考慮使用「四微曲」OLED面板。另一名微博爆料者「定焦數碼」近期則再度提及，新機可能大量運用玻璃材質，並借鑑iPhone Air的部分設計元素。
不過，iPhone 20 Pro距離正式亮相仍有一段時間，目前相關規格均未獲蘋果證實。微博爆料消息的準確度也不一，儘管「數碼閒聊站」過去擁有一定命中紀錄，現階段仍應視為市場傳聞。
這項爆料也與Jefferies分析師日前的說法形成對比。Jefferies認為，蘋果可能已因量產難度取消20週年全玻璃iPhone計畫，但近期多項供應鏈傳聞仍指向玻璃占比更高、四曲面及無邊框視覺等設計方向，顯示相關方案可能尚未完全遭到放棄。
paras_en: Apple is reportedly preparing a new design for the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, with the iPhone 20 Pro series expected to maintain the existing screen aspect ratio while increasing the display area, creating a near 'borderless' visual effect through special curved glass.

Weibo leaker 'Digital Chat Station' revealed on Wednesday that the iPhone 20 Pro and iPhone 20 Pro Max, codenamed V73 and V74, will have slightly larger screens than their predecessors, but the aspect ratio will not change significantly.

According to previous reports, Apple (AAPL-US) is testing 6.4-inch and 7-inch screens for the iPhone 20 Pro and iPhone 20 Pro Max, respectively. In comparison, the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max have screen sizes of 6.3 inches and 6.9 inches, indicating that the new devices may increase by 0.1 inches each.

This design does not directly use a curved display panel. The leak suggests that the iPhone 20 Pro series may retain a flat screen and cover it with specially shaped four-curved glass, using optical refraction to weaken the screen border and create an effect where the edges are almost invisible.
In other words, the so-called 'borderless' effect is mainly created by the glass shape and light refraction, and does not necessarily mean that the physical border will completely disappear.

Similar news has been leaked multiple times before. 'Digital Chat Station' mentioned in July that the iPhone 20 Pro series may use 6.4-inch and 7-inch screens, and in April, it was revealed that Apple was considering using 'four micro-curved' OLED panels. Another Weibo leaker, 'Digital Focus', recently mentioned that the new device may heavily use glass materials and borrow design elements from the iPhone Air.

However, the iPhone 20 Pro is still some time away from its official release, and the related specifications have not been confirmed by Apple. The accuracy of Weibo leaks is also inconsistent, although 'Digital Chat Station' has a certain track record, it should still be viewed as market rumors at this stage.

This leak also contradicts the statement made by Jefferies analyst recently. Jefferies believes that Apple may have canceled the all-glass iPhone plan for the 20th anniversary due to production difficulties, but recent supply chain rumors still point to a higher glass content, four-curved, and 'borderless' visual design, indicating that the plan may not have been completely abandoned.

items.title: 減產兩成仍價跌50% 天然鑽石恐重演百年珍珠崩盤
items.title_en: Natural Diamond Prices May Plummet 50% as Lab-Grown Diamonds Gain Popularity
paras: 天然鑽石長年建立的高價神話正加速瓦解。隨著實驗室培育鑽石技術快速進步，價格更低、品質相當的人工鑽石持續侵蝕市場，天然鑽石賴以維繫價格的「稀缺性溢價」逐漸消失。
8月上半月，彭博終端機追蹤的鑽石標準指數已跌至歷史新低，市場人士警告，天然鑽石價格下行的轉折點可能已經出現，未來數年跌勢恐進一步加速。
實驗室鑽石崛起 稀缺溢價瓦解
天然鑽石市場面臨的核心壓力，來自實驗室培育鑽石技術突飛猛進。社群平台X用戶Crémieux指出，實驗室培育鑽石技術進步速度驚人，如今大多數訂婚戒指已經使用實驗室鑽石，並不令人意外。
實驗室培育鑽石與天然鑽石在物理與化學性質上完全相同，一般消費者甚至專業檢測設備，在實際使用情境下都幾乎難以分辨。市場評論人Saul Sadka指出，即使動用價值2萬美元的專業檢測儀器區分兩者，對一般消費者而言也沒有太大實際意義。
更重要的是，消費者主動選擇實驗室培育鑽石的理由正在增加。Sadka認為，多數買家並不在乎鑽石究竟來自礦場或實驗室，這也使天然鑽石最後一道「天然」護城河逐漸失去作用。
他指出，無論消費者願意為天然屬性支付多少倍溢價，只要實驗室培育鑽石的生產成本持續下降、甚至趨近於零，天然鑽石溢價的絕對價值也將愈來愈低。消費者或許願意為相同產品背後的故事多付一些錢，但不可能無限制支付高價。
產量砍兩成 價格仍跌約50%
面對實驗室培育鑽石的強勢競爭，天然鑽石生產商近年已透過大幅削減產量，希望限制供給、支撐價格。
根據Sadka引用的數據，過去四年間，天然鑽石產量已削減約20%，由每年1.2億克拉降至9,800萬克拉。然而，即使供給明顯收縮，天然鑽石價格過去四年仍累計下跌約50%。
Sadka認為，減產只能延後價格崩跌，而無法逆轉市場結構。一旦天然鑽石產量恢復至先前水準，價格下跌速度可能進一步加快。
天然鑽石過去引以為傲的「永恆」特性，如今也可能成為另一項供給壓力。
隨著嬰兒潮世代陸續離世，其遺產中的大量天然鑽石可能流入二手市場，形成新的供給來源。屆時，即使是高端市場的部分需求，也可能透過既有鑽石存量滿足，而不必再依賴礦山與切割商。Sadka形容，鑽石確實是永恆的，但這項特質如今反而成為產業的詛咒。
百年前珍珠崩盤恐重演
Sadka進一步將天然鑽石目前的處境，與百年前珍珠市場的崩潰相提並論。當時技術進步同樣終結天然珍珠的稀缺神話，使其在50年間從上流社會的象徵，逐漸轉變為平庸的刻板符號。
他預期，鑽石可能經歷類似、甚至更劇烈的形象逆轉，未來鑽石甚至可能從階層與排他性的象徵，轉變為「俗氣」的標誌。
這種文化形象的轉變，對鑽石產業的殺傷力可能比單純價格下跌更大。一旦鑽石與財富、品味之間長年建立的連結徹底斷裂，支撐整個產業的商業邏輯也將面臨更深層的挑戰。
相關衝擊已開始在部分市場浮現。Sadka以以色列為例指出，鑽石產業過去一度占該國國內生產毛額（GDP）的3%，如今比重已降至0.2%以下。
對天然鑽石產業鏈而言，這場變化已不只是一次景氣循環式的價格修正，而是稀缺性、供需結構與文化價值同時遭到挑戰。
對消費者而言，若仍將天然鑽石、尤其婚戒視為具有保值能力的資產，原有的價值儲藏邏輯也正在動搖。正如Sadka所言，如果購買婚戒時仍期待它未來能夠保值，恐怕要失望了。
paras_en: The long-standing high-price myth of natural diamonds is rapidly crumbling. As lab-grown diamond technology advances, lower-priced and equally high-quality artificial diamonds continue to erode the market, causing the 'scarcity premium' that natural diamonds rely on to maintain their price to gradually disappear.

In the first half of August, the diamond standard index tracked by Bloomberg terminals fell to a historic low, with market participants warning that the turning point for natural diamond prices may have arrived, and the decline may accelerate in the coming years.
The rise of lab-grown diamonds is undermining the natural diamond market, with the core pressure coming from the rapid progress of lab-grown diamond technology.
A user on social media platform X, Crémieux, pointed out that the progress of lab-grown diamond technology is remarkable, and it's no surprise that most engagement rings now use lab-grown diamonds.

Lab-grown diamonds are physically and chemically identical to natural diamonds, and even professional detection equipment can barely distinguish between them in practical applications. Market commentator Saul Sadka noted that even with a $20,000 professional detector, it's not very meaningful for ordinary consumers.

More importantly, consumers are increasingly choosing lab-grown diamonds. Sadka believes that most buyers don't care whether the diamond comes from a mine or a lab, which is causing the last line of defense for natural diamonds - their 'natural' attribute - to lose its effectiveness.

He pointed out that no matter how much consumers are willing to pay for the natural attribute, as long as the production cost of lab-grown diamonds continues to decline, the absolute value of the natural diamond premium will also decrease. Consumers may be willing to pay more for the story behind the product, but they can't pay an unlimited price.
Despite production being cut by 20%, prices have still fallen by about 50%.
Facing the strong competition from lab-grown diamonds, natural diamond producers have reduced production in recent years to restrict supply and support prices.

According to data cited by Sadka, natural diamond production has been cut by about 20% over the past four years, from 120 million carats to 98 million carats. However, even with a significant reduction in supply, natural diamond prices have still fallen by about 50% over the past four years.

Sadka believes that reducing production can only delay the price collapse and cannot reverse the market structure. Once natural diamond production returns to its previous level, the price decline may accelerate further.
The 'eternal' characteristic that natural diamonds once proudly touted may also become another source of supply pressure.

As the baby boomer generation passes away, the large number of natural diamonds in their estates may flow into the second-hand market, forming a new source of supply. At that time, even part of the demand in the high-end market may be met through existing diamond inventory, rather than relying on mines and cutters. Sadka described diamonds as indeed 'eternal', but this characteristic has now become a curse for the industry.
The collapse of the natural pearl market a hundred years ago may be repeated.

Sadka further compared the current situation of natural diamonds to the collapse of the natural pearl market a hundred years ago. At that time, technological progress also ended the scarcity myth of natural pearls, causing them to change from a symbol of the upper class to a mundane symbol over 50 years.

He expects that diamonds may experience a similar, or even more dramatic, reversal of image, with diamonds possibly changing from a symbol of hierarchy and exclusivity to a 'tacky' symbol in the future.

This cultural image shift could have a more significant impact on the diamond industry than a simple price drop. Once the connection between diamonds and wealth, taste, which has been established over the years, is completely broken, the commercial logic that supports the entire industry will face a deeper challenge.

The related impact has already begun to emerge in some markets. Sadka cited Israel as an example, where the diamond industry once accounted for 3% of the country's GDP but now accounts for less than 0.2%.

For the natural diamond industry chain, this change is no longer just a price correction in the form of a business cycle, but a challenge to scarcity, supply and demand structure, and cultural value at the same time.

For consumers, if they still view natural diamonds, especially engagement rings, as a store of value, the original value storage logic is also being shaken. As Sadka said, if you expect your engagement ring to appreciate in value in the future, you may be disappointed.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元抹去CPI數據後跌幅 荷姆茲海峽局勢不明推升避險需求
paras: 美元周三(12日)從盤中低點反彈並小幅走升，中東和平協議的不確定性，抵銷了符合預期的7月消費者通膨數據所帶來的影響。最新通膨數據降低了市場對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期。
近期投資人提高對貨幣政策收緊的預期，帶動美元走強，但最新通膨數據並未出現足以延續這波漲勢的意外升幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報99.98。CPI數據早上公布後，美元指數一度擴大跌幅，觸及99.61盤中低點，之後回升並在中午前轉為走高。
外匯市場參與者周三將焦點集中在7月消費者物價指數(CPI)報告，以尋找更多貨幣政策前景的線索。上周五公布的7月就業報告弱於預期，導致市場迅速重新調整對聯準會9月升息的預期。
根據美國勞工統計局數據，7月整體CPI月增0.1%，6月則下跌0.4%。年增率則從6月的3.5%放緩至3.4%。扣除食品及能源價格的核心CPI，7月月增0.2%，6月則持平。年增率也從2.6%放緩至2.5%。上述4項數據均符合市場預期。
周四將接著公布7月生產者物價指數(PPI)。雖然CPI與PPI都是市場廣泛關注的通膨指標，但聯準會更偏好追蹤個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，以評估通膨情勢。CPI與PPI中的部分項目會被納入PCE的計算。
對聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)而言，這些符合預期的數據可能讓其有更多空間維持利率不變，而不是升息，尤其是在周五公布疲弱就業報告之後。
利率市場也反映出這項預期。CME FedWatch工具顯示，CPI公布後，市場預期9月維持利率不變的機率從54%升至62%。
荷姆茲海峽緊張持續 布油徘徊90美元
目光轉向中東，油價周三震盪，市場持續受到各方對荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)不同說法的影響。布蘭特原油(Brent)期貨一度短暫觸及每桶90美元。
目前看來，重新開放這條重要水道的和平協議進展有限，美國與伊朗仍持續宣稱掌握這條重要航道的控制權。
美國總統川普在Truth Social上表示，「美國完全控制荷姆茲海峽。」
伊朗國營媒體周二稍早報導，伊朗再次提出要求，表示美國必須停止各條戰線上的敵對行動，並解凍遭凍結的資產，荷姆茲海峽才會重新開放。相關說法引述伊朗國家安全委員會主席Mohsen Rezaei向中國駐德黑蘭大使發表的言論。
據伊朗國營媒體，Rezaei表示，「在美國改變行為並接受伊朗的條件之前，荷姆茲海峽不會開放。任何伊朗與阿曼之間的航運協議，都是獨立於荷姆茲海峽關閉之外的另一件事。」
Kpler數據顯示，周二獲確認通過荷姆茲海峽的船隻數量小幅增加，但整體市場氣氛仍保持謹慎，加上新的攻擊事件進一步加劇擔憂。
葉門叛軍「青年運動」(Houthi)在曼德海峽(Mandeb Strait)攻擊商業航運，造成4名貨輪船員及2名葉門救援人員死亡。
日元持續回吐干預後漲幅
其他主要貨幣方面，日元兌美元走弱，持續回吐上月底華盛頓與東京進行歷史性聯合干預後取得漲幅。美元兌日元上漲0.1%，至159.46。
稍早公布的最新Reuters Tankan調查顯示，受強勁半導體需求及國內消費旺盛帶動，日本企業信心在8月有所改善。這項調查旨在提前反映日本央行(BoJ)季度企業短期經濟觀測調查的結果。

items.title: 歐洲迎來百年首見日全食！飯店房價一晚飆破千美元
items.title_en: Europe Sees Rare Total Solar Eclipse, Hotel Prices Soar Past $1,000 per Night
paras: 歐洲罕見日全食週三 (12 日) 登場，觀測帶橫跨冰島、格陵蘭、英國、葡萄牙及西班牙北部，帶動旅遊需求短時間暴增。冰島首都雷克雅維克與西班牙畢爾包等熱門觀測城市，飯店及短期租屋價格一度突破每晚 1,000 美元 (約新台幣 3.23 萬元)。
旅宿數據公司 Lighthouse Intelligence 於 7 月中旬、距離日食約一個月時調查發現，雷克雅維克日食當週的飯店平均房價達每晚 1,012 美元 (約新台幣 3.26 萬元)，較去年同期增加一倍；短期租屋均價更升至 1,172 美元 (約新台幣 3.78 萬元)，年增 178%。
西班牙北部同樣出現明顯漲勢。畢爾包短期租屋均價攀至每晚 1,088 美元 (約新台幣 3.51 萬元)，較去年同期大漲 206%；飯店均價則上漲 35%，來到 315 美元 (約新台幣 1.02 萬元)。位於日全食帶外圍的聖地牙哥－德孔波斯特拉相對便宜，飯店均價為 193 美元 (約新台幣 6,224 元)，年增 13%。
Lighthouse 內容行銷主管 Jonathan Gough 表示，面對世界盃或泰勒絲演唱會等「一生難得一遇」的大型活動，旅館業者通常會測試市場能夠承受的最高價格，這次日全食也不例外。
不過，冰島旅館業者最初採取的高價策略並未完全奏效。最新數據顯示，截至 8 月 10 日，雷克雅維克與首都周邊地區 8 月 12 日最低可訂房價，已較 5 月中旬分別下調 46%與 51%，降至 805 美元 (約新台幣 2.60 萬元)及 793 美元 (約新台幣 2.56 萬元)，反映業者在活動前夕加大折扣以消化空房。
Gough 指出，冰島業者早在一年多前便以正常房價的三至四倍試水溫，但近三個月持續調降價格；西班牙北部業者則採取相反策略，春季仍維持一般價格，隨著訂房量增加才逐步漲價。
即使部分地區價格回落，日食當天的住宿需求仍相當強勁。西班牙拉科魯尼亞的需求已達平日五倍以上，在房間供給有限的情況下，價格成為旅客能否入住的主要門檻。
短期租屋市場也明顯受惠。AirDNA 數據顯示，冰島約 9,000 間可出租房源中，接近 64%位於日全食帶內；西班牙約 36.54 萬間房源中，也有約 21%位於觀測路徑範圍。
冰島日全食帶內的短租需求較去年同期增加 40%，高於其他地區的 13.2%。西班牙今年夏季氣溫一度超過華氏 104 度 (約攝氏 40 度)，8 月 11 日至 12 日晚間，日食帶內短租需求年減 1.6%，但跌幅仍小於其他地區的 9.1%，顯示日全食在一定程度上抵銷極端高溫對旅遊市場的衝擊。
Gough 認為，這場天文奇景確實為歐洲部分地區帶來強勁但高度集中的觀光效益，住宿熱潮可能只維持一至兩晚，難以改變整個旅遊旺季。相較之下，熱浪及極端天氣正在改變歐洲人的夏季旅遊選擇，對觀光業造成的影響可望比日全食更加長遠。
paras_en: A rare total solar eclipse is set to appear in Europe on Wednesday (12th), with the observation path spanning across Iceland, Greenland, the UK, Portugal, and northern Spain, leading to a surge in tourism demand. Reykjavik, the capital of Iceland, and Bilbao, Spain, among other popular observation cities, saw hotel and short-term rental prices skyrocket to over $1,000 per night.

According to data from Lighthouse Intelligence, which surveyed in mid-July, about a month before the eclipse, Reykjavik's average hotel price for the eclipse week reached $1,012 per night, a 100% increase from the same period last year. Short-term rental prices averaged $1,172 per night, a 178% increase from the previous year.

The northern region of Spain also saw a significant price hike. Bilbao's short-term rental prices soared to $1,088 per night, a 206% increase from the same period last year, while hotel prices rose 35% to $315 per night. Santiago de Compostela, located on the periphery of the eclipse path, was relatively more affordable, with hotel prices averaging $193 per night, a 13% increase from the previous year.

Lighthouse's content marketing manager, Jonathan Gough, explained that hotel operators typically test the market's ability to bear the highest prices during large events like the World Cup or Taylor Swift concerts. This time, the total solar eclipse was no exception.

However, Icelandic hotel operators' initial high-price strategy did not entirely pay off. Latest data shows that, as of August 10, Reykjavik and the surrounding area's lowest available hotel prices for August 12 had dropped by 46% and 51%, respectively, from mid-May, to $805 and $793 per night, reflecting operators' efforts to clear inventory by offering discounts before the event.

Gough noted that Icelandic operators had been testing the market with prices three to four times the normal rate over a year and a half ago, but had been continuously reducing prices over the past three months. Spanish operators in the north, on the other hand, had maintained normal prices during the spring and only began to raise them as bookings increased.

Even as prices fell in some areas, demand for accommodations remained strong on the day of the eclipse. In La Coruña, Spain, demand was over five times the usual level, with prices becoming the main barrier to entry in a market with limited supply.

The short-term rental market also benefited significantly. AirDNA data showed that about 64% of the approximately 9,000 available rentals in Iceland were located within the eclipse path, while about 21% of the approximately 365,400 rentals in Spain were within the observation path.

Short-term rental demand in Iceland's eclipse path increased by 40% compared to the same period last year, outpacing the 13.2% increase in other areas. In Spain, demand for short-term rentals in the eclipse path decreased by 1.6% from last year, but was still lower than the 9.1% decline in other areas, indicating that the eclipse had some mitigating effect on the impact of extreme heat on the tourism market.

Gough believes that this celestial event has brought strong but highly concentrated tourism benefits to certain European regions, with the accommodation boom likely to last only one to two nights and not significantly altering the overall tourism season. In contrast, heatwaves and extreme weather are changing Europeans' summer travel choices, potentially having a more lasting impact on the tourism industry.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉溫和CPI消除升息疑慮 費半強漲近2.5% 記憶體類股噴高
items.title_en: Soft CPI Eases Rate Hike Concerns, Semis Surge 2.5%, Memory Stocks Soar
paras: 美國7月通膨略為降溫，強化聯準會9月維持利率不變的預期，加上AI基礎設施及記憶體類股強勢上漲，美股週三 (12 日) 多收高。費半指數勁揚近 2.5%，那斯達克指數上漲0.54%，標普500指數漲0.26%，道瓊指數幾乎收在平盤。
美國7月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 年增3.4%，符合市場預期，低於6月的3.5%；月增率則為0.1%。通膨持續降溫後，交易員轉而押注聯準會9月將按兵不動，扭轉前一日升息與維持利率不變機率約各半的局面。
不過，美國通膨率仍高於聯準會2%目標，加上中東局勢持續推高能源價格及美債殖利率，使聯準會官員對是否升息仍存在分歧。
美國與伊朗就重新開放荷姆茲海峽的談判持續陷入僵局。美方週二對一艘試圖穿越阿曼灣、懸掛巴拿馬國旗的船隻開火，進一步加劇市場對原油供應的擔憂，布蘭特原油期貨一度逼近每桶90美元。
油價上漲也推高美國汽油價格。全美普通汽油平均價格週三升至每加侖4.03美元，較一個月前上漲約0.16美元，創歷年8月中旬同期新高。
美股週三 (12 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭盡墨。Meta (META-US) 下跌 3.38%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.87%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 微跌 0.08%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.26%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 1.83%。
費城半導體族群多收紅。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 1.82%；博通 (AVGO-US) 微跌 0.01%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 3.03%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 大漲 4.29%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 0.24%。
記憶體與儲存類股同步走高。美光科技 (MU-US) 大漲 4.92%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 上漲 3.69%；閃迪 (SNDK-US) 勁揚 5.76%；希捷科技 (STX-US) 大漲 7.03%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 狂飆 9.01%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.68%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 1.63%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.95%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 微跌 0.12%。
企業新聞

The S&P 500 index rose 0.26%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was little changed, and the Nasdaq Composite index rose 0.54%.

US July consumer price index (CPI) rose 3.4% year-over-year, in line with market expectations, and below June's 3.5%. The month-over-month rate was 0.1%. After inflation continued to ease, traders shifted their bets to a 50-50 chance of the Fed keeping rates steady in September, reversing the previous day's 50-50 chance of a rate hike.

However, US inflation remains above the Fed's 2% target, and the ongoing Middle East tensions continue to push up energy prices and US Treasury yields, leaving Fed officials divided on whether to raise rates.

US and Iran negotiations over reopening the Strait of Hormuz remain stalled. The US fired on a ship trying to cross the Gulf of Oman, carrying a Panamanian flag, on Tuesday, further exacerbating concerns over oil supply, with Brent crude futures briefly touching $90 per barrel.

Rising oil prices also pushed up US gasoline prices. The national average price of regular gasoline rose to $4.03 per gallon on Wednesday, up about 0.16 dollars from a month ago, a new high for the August mid-month period.
US stocks on Wednesday (12) showed the following performances:

Wall Street analysis

There is still one more inflation report before the Fed's September meeting, but unless the numbers show a sharp change in direction, the Fed may keep rates steady next month.

paras: 台泥(1101-TW)今(12)日公告上半年財報，純益32.8億元，年增241%，每股純益0.38元；另外，董事會也通過，整合旗下土、葡及非洲等水泥及混凝土建材相關業務，納入新設子公司Cimpor International Holdings，並以該公司為主體，申請於海外證券交易市場首次公開發行股票及掛牌交易。
台泥表示，Cimpor International目前以英國倫敦證券交易所或泛歐交易所作為可能的掛牌市場，台泥也預計於10月13日召開臨時股東會討論Cimpor International海外IPO案。至於全球儲能發展與建置的 NHOA Energy，以及發展歐洲充儲一體業務的 Atlante，不納入本次上市範圍，後續將另行評估。
台泥表示，推動 Cimpor International 海外上市，主要目的在於健全其資本結構、建立更多元的籌資管道，並提升國際資本市場能見度及吸引全球專業人才，透過更清楚的事業定位與獨立籌資能力，預期將有助於歐亞非洲及周邊市場水泥及混凝土建材事業的長期發展，進一步提升集團整體營收及獲利能力。
台泥指出，本次上市預計採取發行新股及轉讓既有股份並行的方式，依上市地相關規範，公眾持股比例預計不低於 Cimpor International 總股本的 10%。實際發行規模、股權比例、價格及交易條件，仍將依資金需求、市場環境、投資人認購情形，以及與主管機關、交易所和證券承銷商的協商結果確定。
台泥強調，Cimpor International 完成上市後，台泥持股比例雖可能因股權分散而有所調整，但仍將透過 TCC Dutch Holdings 維持對 Cimpor International 的控制權，並持續將其納入合併財務報表，另外，OYAK Çimento Fabrikaları A.Ş.的現有營運及其於伊斯坦堡證券交易所的上市地位亦不受影響。
台泥上半年營收達712.9億元，年增1%，毛利率18.2%，年增2.2個百分點、營業利益51.7億元，年增51%，獲利成長主要受惠土葡水泥業務銷售量價同步提升，以及旗下和平電力則因營運天數增加、能量費率上升，均帶動獲利增加。
不過，兩岸水泥業務仍面臨市場挑戰。台灣市場受到房市疲弱及進口水泥影響，加上預拌混凝土銷量減少，銷量及毛利率下降；中國大陸市場則因供需失衡及競爭加劇，水泥價格與毛利皆承壓。
截至2026年第二季底，台泥總資產為5,960億元、總負債為2,966億元，負債占總資產比率約49.8%，整體財務結構維持穩健。台泥表示，面對全球產業環境變化，公司將持續強化低碳建材、能源事業及國際市場布局，提升營運效率與財務韌性，穩健推進企業轉型。
paras_en: Taiwan Cement (1101-TW) announced its first-half financial report today, with a net profit of NT$3.28 billion, a year-on-year increase of 241%, and an EPS of NT$0.38. The board of directors also approved the integration of its cement and concrete products businesses in Taiwan, Portugal, and Africa into a new subsidiary, Cimpor International Holdings, which will be listed on an overseas stock exchange.

Taiwan Cement stated that Cimpor International is currently considering listing on the London Stock Exchange or the Euronext exchange, and the company plans to hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on October 13 to discuss the listing of Cimpor International. NHOA Energy and Atlante, which are involved in energy storage and charging infrastructure, respectively, will not be included in the initial public offering (IPO) and will be evaluated separately.

Taiwan Cement stated that the main purpose of listing Cimpor International is to strengthen its capital structure, establish a more diversified funding channel, and enhance its visibility and attractiveness to international capital markets. This is expected to help the company's long-term development in the cement and concrete products markets in Europe, Asia, Africa, and surrounding regions, and to improve the company's overall revenue and profitability.

Taiwan Cement stated that the listing will be done through the issuance of new shares and the transfer of existing shares, with a public float of at least 10% of Cimpor International's total shares. The actual issuance size, shareholding ratio, price, and trading conditions will be determined based on the company's funding needs, market environment, investor subscription, and discussions with regulatory authorities, exchanges, and underwriters.

Taiwan Cement emphasized that even after the listing, the company will maintain control over Cimpor International through TCC Dutch Holdings and will continue to consolidate its financial statements. The listing will not affect OYAK Çimento Fabrikaları A.Ş.'s existing operations or its listing on the Istanbul Stock Exchange.

Taiwan Cement's first-half revenue reached NT$71.29 billion, a year-on-year increase of 1%, with a gross margin of 18.2%, a year-on-year increase of 2.2 percentage points, and an operating profit of NT$5.17 billion, a year-on-year increase of 51%. The company's profitability growth was mainly driven by the increase in sales volume and price of cement and concrete products in Taiwan and Portugal, as well as the increase in operating days and energy prices at its Ande Power plant.

However, the company's cement business in Taiwan and China faces market challenges. The Taiwanese market is affected by the weak housing market and the impact of imported cement, while the Chinese market is affected by supply-demand imbalances and increased competition, leading to downward pressure on cement prices and margins.

As of the end of the second quarter of 2026, Taiwan Cement's total assets were NT$596 billion, with total liabilities of NT$296.6 billion, representing a debt-to-asset ratio of approximately 49.8%. The company stated that it will continue to strengthen its low-carbon materials, energy, and international business, improve operational efficiency and financial resilience, and promote a stable transformation of the company.

paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(12)日召開重訊記者會，宣布將透過全資子公司「台信電訊」公開收購精誠資訊(6214-TW)普通股，目標增持至少39%，總持股將過半，全案收購價金上限達291.3億元。總經理林之晨指出，對於此次收購所產生的綜效具高度信心，取得過半股權後，最快今年可大幅提升雙方營收與獲利。
林之晨認為，此次公開收購精誠股權，希望在AI時代裡，透過雙方深度的ICT結盟，整合資訊IT與電信CT，創造「跨售」、「AI」與「區域化」三大綜效，目標在資服產業的市占率能夠從7%，倍增至14%，進一步推升台灣大在4、5年後營收可達千億規模。
林之晨指出，此次公開收購的對價為一半現金、一半換股，應賣1股精誠普通股，可換取台灣大普通股0.84股及現金92.5元。
若以台灣大及精誠今天收盤價計算，相當於每股收購價約當184.5元，溢價約29.5%；以近一季平均收盤價計算，溢價則約32.5%；以近半年收盤價計算，溢價約38.5%。
台灣大說明，此次目標取得至少39%、最高58%精誠資訊股權，全案收購價金為195.8億元至291.3億元。另外，此次收購所需對價總數為台信電訊持有台灣大普通股89186829股到132636822股(約占台灣大2.4至3.6%股權)，現金對價總額為98.21至146.06億元，將以自有資金及台灣大集團內部關係人借款支應。
林之晨提到，此次公開收購預計8月18日開始，目標50天內完成，須向公平會申請並獲得通過，且收購股份需達39%，待2項條件達成後才可交割。待台灣大取得精誠過半股權，未來除可用權益法認列獲利，若經董事會改選，也能夠合併報表，希望最快今年就可以發生。
因此林之晨表示，短期首要任務就是在股權過半後，進行董事會改選，但他強調，改選後還是希望維持現在經營團隊的穩定。同時，雙方團隊將進行深度策略聯盟，包括業務與商品資訊的交換，讓綜效極大化。
針對日本與東南亞市場，林之晨指出，精誠在新加坡成立SYSTEX Asia東南亞營運總部，在日本也與伊藤忠商事合作，待收購完成，將進一步與精誠共同在東南亞與日本市場推進AI相關業務布局。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) held a major press conference today (the 12th) announcing that it will publicly acquire ordinary shares of Systex Information (6214‑TW) through its wholly‑owned subsidiary Taiwan Telecom. The goal is to increase its holding by at least 39% to a majority stake, with the total purchase price capped at NT$29.13 billion. General Manager Lin Chih‑chen said the company is highly confident about the synergies from the deal and, once it holds more than half the shares, it could significantly boost both parties’ revenue and profit as early as this year.

Lin said the public acquisition of Systex aims to forge a deep ICT alliance in the AI era, integrating information‑technology (IT) and telecommunications (CT) to create three major synergies – cross‑selling, AI, and regionalization. The target is to double Systex’s market share in the IT services sector from 7% to 14%, which would help Taiwan Mobile’s revenue reach the NT$1 trillion level in four to five years.

Lin explained that the consideration for the public purchase will be half cash and half share‑swap: for each Systex ordinary share sold, the seller will receive 0.84 Taiwan Mobile ordinary shares plus NT$92.5 in cash.

Based on today’s closing prices of Taiwan Mobile and Systex, the implied per‑share purchase price is about NT$184.5, a premium of roughly 29.5%. Using the average closing price over the past quarter the premium is about 32.5%, and using the average over the past six months the premium is about 38.5%.

Taiwan Mobile clarified that it aims to acquire at least 39% and up to 58% of Systex, with the total purchase price ranging from NT$19.58 billion to NT$29.13 billion. The consideration includes Taiwan Telecom holding between 89,186,829 and 132,636,822 Taiwan Mobile ordinary shares (about 2.4%–3.6% of Taiwan Mobile’s equity) and a cash component of NT$9.821 billion to NT$14.606 billion, to be funded with internal cash and loans from related parties within the Taiwan Mobile group.

Lin said the public acquisition is slated to start on August 18 and is expected to be completed within 50 days, subject to filing with and approval by the Fair Trade Commission. The transaction will only close once the 39% share threshold is met and two other conditions are satisfied. After Taiwan Mobile obtains a majority stake in Systex, it can recognize profits under the equity method and, if the board is re‑elected, consolidate Systex’s financial statements, potentially as early as this year.

Therefore, Lin stated that the short‑term priority after crossing the 50% ownership line is to hold a board election, while emphasizing that the existing management team will remain stable after the election. Both companies will also deepen their strategic alliance, including the exchange of business and product information, to maximize synergies.

Regarding Japan and Southeast Asia, Lin noted that Systex has established a Southeast Asia operations headquarters, SYSTEX Asia, in Singapore and has a partnership with Itochu Corp. in Japan. Once the acquisition is completed, the two firms will jointly advance AI‑related business initiatives in Southeast Asian and Japanese markets.

【奇鋐法說會問答完整清單 (Q&A)】 

Q1：今年下半年的營收與毛利展望為何？ 

回答：公司維持先前的展望，下半年產品陸續進入量產階段，整體營收與獲利預計逐季走高，下半年表現將優於上半年(實際狀況仍需視客戶拉貨時程與供應鏈狀況而定)。此外，公司持續引進自動化設備生產，對整體毛利率有顯著幫助，管理層對未來保持樂觀。

Q2：公司對於水冷(Liquid Cooling)業務的營收比重如何拆分？ 

回答：公司不對外拆分水冷業務的單一營收比重。主因是水冷專案包含 Cooling、Manifold、Quick Disconnect (QD) 等多項組件，部分專案更涵蓋機構件與風扇。公司定位為「全方位熱能與機構解決方案提供者(Total Thermal and Mechanical Solution Provider)」，內部管理以專案與客戶維度為主，不以氣冷/水冷劃分。但可確定的是，AI Server 對營收的貢獻比重持續上升。

Q3：NVIDIA GB200(或 B200)水冷產品的出貨進度與新廠貢獻時程？ 

回答：完全依照客戶給予的專案排程推進。目前新廠針對相關產品已開始進入量產階段，預計於第三季(Q3)開始產生營收貢獻。

Q4：針對 Google、Amazon 等大型 CSP 客戶的 ASIC/TPU 專案，供貨情況與滲透率為何？ 

回答：公司不評論單一客戶細節，但強調在核心 ASIC 客戶群中皆維持主導的供應商地位。水冷滲透率正顯著提高，許多客戶的第一代、第二代 ASIC 專案已開始放量生產，公司均為主要供應商，並持續提供設計、驗證到量產的一站式服務。

Q5：ASIC 與 GPU 散熱產品的發展方向為何？2027 年 ASIC 比重是否會超越 GPU？ 

回答：公司並未針對 ASIC 與 GPU 做細項比例統計，且對公司而言兩者並非二選一。無論是 ASIC 還是 GPU 平臺，對於散熱功耗與機櫃密度的需求都在大幅提升，因此兩大平臺都會持續出貨並共同受益。

Q6：雙相浸沒式水冷(Two-phase Cooling)的開發進度與市場接受度如何？ 

回答：公司擁有專業研發團隊且技術成熟，雙相水冷的散熱表現確實優於單相水冷。然而，評估目前晶片 TDP 與系統可靠度後，客戶現階段權衡下仍以「單相直接水冷(Single-phase Cold Plate)」為最適方案。散熱技術會隨需求漸進式演進，不會出現一夕之間的斷崖式技術更替。

Q7：若未來晶片功耗(TDP)達到 3000W 到 5000W 以上，散熱方案如何因應？ 

回答：公司現階段已可提供 3000W 以上的散熱解決方案，技術上並無物理天花板。未來的解法包含：強化單相水冷、優化機櫃架構、調校流量、採用裸晶封裝或金屬套件(Metal Kit)等，會依據客戶系統層級的限制提供客製化組合。

Q8：機殼與機櫃(Server Chassis/Rack)事業的展望與毛利變化？ 

回答：隨著機櫃密度提升，機殼需要承載 Manifold、風扇、水冷組件等，結構強度、氣流設計與可維修性難度大增，帶動單櫃價值量與設計門檻顯著提升。雖然不針對單一產品評論毛利率，但整體發展趨勢會越來越好，機殼/機構件將隨水冷產品一同強勁成長。

Q9：今年的資本支出(Capex)規劃與籌資計畫？ 

回答：今年的 Capital Expenditure (Capex) 預計約為新臺幣 150 億元，明年的 Capex 會比今年更多(產能擴充以越南廠區為主)。目前營運現金流與銀行額度相當充裕，足以支應現有擴產計畫，暫無其他籌資計畫。

Q10：面對市場對 CSP 客戶 Capex 投資回報的疑慮，公司對 AI 長期趨勢的看法？ 

回答：公司堅信 AI 趨勢是真實且持續發展的。整體產業在技術、資源與資本上的投入不斷增加，水冷在資料中心(Data Center)的滲透率今年確定會持續提升(預計滲透率將超過 50%)。

paras_en: 1. Qihong (3017-TW) detailed Q2 2026 financial and operational results. Answer: The company does not disclose a single revenue share for liquid‑cooling because projects include cooling modules, manifolds, quick disconnects and often mechanical parts and fans. Qihong positions itself as a total thermal and mechanical solution provider, managing projects by customer and project rather than by air‑ vs. liquid‑cooling. However, the contribution of AI servers to revenue is clearly increasing.

6. Q3: What is the shipment progress of NVIDIA GB200 (or B200) liquid‑cooling products and the timeline for contribution from the new plant? Answer: Progress follows the customer‑provided project schedule. The new plant has already begun mass production for the relevant products and is expected to start generating revenue in Q3.

items.title: 永捷上半年EPS-0.1元虧損大幅收斂 下半年加速「多角化發展」策略
items.title_en: Evergreen Chemical Reports Narrower Loss in First Half, Eyes Diversification Strategy
paras: PU合成廠永捷(4714-TW)公告今(2026)年上半年自結財報，稅後淨損1,774 萬元、每股稅後淨損0.1元，整體營運表現較去(2025)年同期虧損大幅收斂。永捷表示，受惠於集團整合協同效益顯現，公司持續優化產品組合結構，嚴控成本費用，加上業外表現挹注業績表現，下半年將採取「垂直整合、多角化發展」策略，深化傳統PU與高科技電子產業之全方位應用。
永捷今年上半年合併營收達11.85 億元、年增76.15％；稅後淨損1,774 萬元，整體營運表現較去年同期虧損大幅收斂，營業毛利為1.73 億元、年增28.76％，受惠於集團整合協同效益顯現，公司持續優化產品組合結構，並嚴控成本費用。

永捷今年7月營收達1.5億元、月增5.65％、年增14.66％；累計2026年1-7 月合併營收達13.34 億元、年增66.13％，7月單月與前7月累計營收雙雙刷新歷年同期新高，成長主因在於公司積極布局高附加價值之環保型PU樹脂與水性PU材料，隨著運動鞋材、機能服飾及傳統皮革等終端市場需求回溫，客戶拉貨力道強勁，帶動產能利用率顯著提升。同時，永捷旗下「荷久暻」建案如期完工交屋並認列房產銷售收入，雙引擎齊發助也推升營收繳出亮眼成績單。
展望2026 年下半年，永捷維持審慎樂觀態度。公司將持續以「綠色環保」與「高附加價值」為核心，發揮台灣廠作為全球研發與運籌中心之優勢，並積極開展海外策略聯盟。
面對國際地緣政治與通膨壓力等全球總體經濟挑戰，永捷表示，將採取「垂直整合、多角化發展」策略，深化傳統PU 市場與高科技電子產業之全方位應用，在產銷政策上，重點布局高固成分與無溶劑濕氣反應型PUR、TPU 產品，油/水性家具革與汽車革，以及快乾型架橋劑與成衣環保水性產品。
paras_en: Evergreen Chemical (4714-TW) announced its unaudited consolidated financial report for the first half of 2026, with a net loss of NT$17.74 million and a net loss per share of NT$0.1. The company's overall performance improved significantly compared to the same period last year.

Evergreen Chemical's consolidated revenue for the first half of 2026 reached NT$1.185 billion, a year-on-year increase of 76.15%. The company's net loss was NT$17.74 million, with a significant improvement in overall performance compared to the same period last year. Gross profit was NT$173 million, a year-on-year increase of 28.76%.

Evergreen Chemical's revenue in July reached NT$150 million, a month-on-month increase of 5.65% and a year-on-year increase of 14.66%. The company's cumulative revenue for January-July 2026 reached NT$1.334 billion, a year-on-year increase of 66.13%. Both the July single-month and cumulative revenue for the first seven months broke new highs, driven by the company's active layout of high-value-added environmentally friendly PU resins and water-based PU materials.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Evergreen Chemical maintains a cautious optimism. The company will continue to focus on 'green and environmentally friendly' and 'high-value-added' products, leveraging its Taiwan-based manufacturing as a global R&D and logistics center, and actively developing overseas strategic partnerships.

In the face of global economic challenges such as international geopolitics and inflationary pressures, Evergreen Chemical will adopt a 'vertical integration and diversification' strategy, deepening its application of traditional PU markets and high-tech electronics industries. The company will focus on developing high-solid content and solvent-free wet reaction type PUR, TPU products, oil/water-based furniture leather and automotive leather, as well as fast-drying type bridging agents and environmentally friendly water-based clothing products.

items.title: 迅得上半年EPS3.79元並將配息3元 還要發行CB籌資逾5億元
items.title_en: XunDe Reports H1 EPS of NT$3.79, Plans NT$3 Dividend, and to Issue Convertible Bonds Raising Over NT$5 Billion
paras: 屬台積電 (2330-TW) 供應鏈的設備廠迅得 (6438-TW) 今(12)日公布最新獲利資訊，2026年上半年稅後純益3.11億元，年增19.07%，每股純益達3.79元，公司擬對上半年股利配息3元，並擬發行5億元無擔保可轉換公司債進行市場籌資。
迅得2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創新高，稅後純益1.66億元，單季獲利也超越首季的 1.45 億元，每股純益2.03元。2026年1-6月營收35.68億元，毛利率26.13%，稅後純益3.11億元，每股純益3.79元。而迅得公布最新營收資訊，迅得2026 年 7 月營收以 6.38 億元改寫歷年同期新高。
迅得營運總部也在遷入的新生廠，產能已進人滿載，將推升 2026 年獲利成長幅度攀高。迅得機械在 2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創新高，法人估計迅得 2026 年第三季單月平均營收在 6 億元之上 ，有機會再創新高，第四季由於安排出貨的半導體設備出貨逐步步入高峰，預估下半年營運勝過 上半年，全年營收將再較 2025 年的 64.67 億元再增 10-15%，再創新高。
迅得擁有在半導體及 PCB 設備需求雙重成長動能，同時，迅得在 PCB 設備指向高階產品廠商的需求，也與臻鼎 - KY(4958-TW) 及景碩 (3189-TW) 有大單確立，其中臻鼎 - KY 下單 10.2 億元，而景碩也在 7 億元之上。。
迅得 2026 年上半年營收 35.68 億元，年增 11.99%，2026 下半年預估在出貨產品組合的有利因素加持下超過上半年表現 ，全年營收估成長 10-15%，而在獲利成長幅度可望以優於營收成長幅度倍數成長呈現。
同時，迅得半導體相關設備出貨上將在第四季起出現明顯成長，半導體設備營收在 2027 年也將維持此一營運旺盛態勢。
迅得在今年第一季營收爲 17.45 億元，稅後純益 1.45 億元，每股純益 1.76 元，第二季營收 18.24 億元，在出貨產品組合、匯率有利及收回逾期帳款挹注之下，迅得 2026 年第二季營收、獲利較首季增加。
在迅得產能規劃方面，迅得新建中壢新生廠的廠房高達 1.2 萬坪，公司營運總部也遷入新生廠；迅得中壢新生廠設有無塵室並主攻半導體設備生產，迅得董事長王年清指出，目前中壢新生廠產能並已經滿載，迅得正設法取得取得其他營運及倉儲空間以確保備妥下半年營運增溫的需求。
paras_en: XunDe (6438‑TW), a equipment supplier in TSMC’s (2330‑TW) supply chain, announced on the 12th its latest profit figures: H1 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$311 million, up 19.07% year‑over‑year, and earnings per share of NT$3.79. The company intends to pay a NT$3 dividend for the first half and plans to issue NT$5 billion of unsecured convertible bonds to raise capital in the market.

In Q2 2026 XunDe recorded revenue of NT$1.824 billion, a new high, with after‑tax net profit of NT$166 million. The quarterly profit also surpassed Q1’s NT$145 million, delivering EPS of NT$2.03. For the January‑June period, revenue reached NT$3.568 billion, gross margin was 26.13%, after‑tax net profit was NT$311 million and EPS was NT$3.79. The company also reported that July 2026 revenue of NT$638 million set a new historical high for the month.

July 2026 revenue was NT$638 million, up 7.61% month‑over‑month and 5.38% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑July 2026 amounted to NT$4.207 billion, an increase of 10.97% from the prior year.

XunDe’s operations headquarters has moved into the new Xinsheng plant, where capacity is already fully loaded, which is expected to lift profit growth in 2026. The machinery segment posted a record Q2 revenue of NT$1.824 billion; analysts estimate that average monthly revenue in Q3 2026 will exceed NT$600 million, potentially setting another record. In Q4, shipments of semiconductor equipment are expected to peak, and the second half is forecasted to outperform the first half. Full‑year revenue is projected to grow 10‑15% over 2025’s NT$6.467 billion, reaching a new high.

XunDe enjoys dual growth momentum from semiconductor and PCB equipment demand. In the PCB segment, targeting high‑end product makers, it has secured large orders from Zhen Ding‑KY (4958‑TW) and Jing Shuo (3189‑TW). Zhen Ding‑KY placed an order worth NT$1.02 billion, while Jing Shuo’s order exceeds NT$700 million.

H1 2026 revenue was NT$3.568 billion, up 11.99% year‑over‑year. The company expects H2 revenue to surpass H1 performance thanks to favorable product‑mix factors, projecting full‑year revenue growth of 10‑15%. Profit growth is anticipated to outpace revenue growth by a multiple.
Semiconductor‑related equipment shipments are expected to show a clear increase starting in Q4, and semiconductor equipment revenue is expected to remain robust throughout 2027.

In Q1 2026, XunDe generated revenue of NT$1.745 billion, after‑tax net profit of NT$145 million and EPS of NT$1.76. In Q2, revenue rose to NT$1.824 billion, driven by a favorable product mix, advantageous exchange‑rate effects and the recovery of overdue receivables, resulting in higher revenue and profit compared with Q1.

Regarding capacity planning, XunDe’s newly built Zhongli Xinsheng plant spans 12,000 ping, and the company’s operations headquarters has relocated there. The plant features a cleanroom and focuses on semiconductor equipment production. Chairman Wang Nianqing noted that the Xinsheng plant’s capacity is already fully utilized, and the company is seeking additional operational and warehousing space to ensure it can meet the increased demand anticipated in the second half of the year.

items.title: 〈聯亞法說〉CW Laser產能供不應求 基板缺料問題不大
items.title_en: Lianya's Law: CW Laser production in short supply, substrate shortage not significant
paras: 聯亞 (3081-TW) 今 (12) 日下午舉行法說會，並自結公告今 ( 2026) 年第 2 季、上半年財報及說明未來布局展望，聯亞因受惠矽光產品需求強勁、出貨持續放大挹注下，第 2 季除了獲利創單新高，在矽光產品上，隨AI資料中心帶動需求，目前產能狀況已相當吃緊，產品中Datacom中CW Laser占比最大，也陸續擴大資本支出及代工因應。
聯亞第 2 季財報繳出三率三升，連續 2 季繳出佳績。隨著資料中心需求持續增加，聯亞表示，矽光需求依然非常強勁，隨著公司與下游代工廠的產能持續攀升，預期矽光產品出貨量在未來幾個季度還會持續增加。
聯亞指出，目前CW Laser產能狀況已相當吃緊，代工廠產能遠遠不足公司需求，也證實的確有些訂單委由外面代工廠代工，同時在AI資料中心持續建置下，CW Laser在光通訊後續發展上具有很大優勢，這也是目前聯亞仍持續擴大資本支出的原因，公司主要產能上還是放在CW Laser上。
此外，針對原料磷化銦(InP)全球持續缺料影響，聯亞也表示，雖受中國管制，但聯亞已與其他供應商有持續接觸，目前基板缺料問題不大。
聯亞強調，未來資料中心在AI應用上從過去scale-out，接下來將會導入光通訊，逐步延伸至EML及接收端光電二極體(PD)等，EML與CW Laser各有應用優勢，並非相互取代或互斥，不同的光通訊傳輸也互有優勢。
paras_en: Lianya (3081-TW) held a law meeting today (12) and announced its second quarter and first half of 2026 financial report, as well as its future layout outlook. Lianya benefited from the strong demand for silicon light products, with continuous shipments increasing, and its second quarter profit reached a new high. In addition, due to the strong demand for silicon light products driven by AI data centers, the current production capacity is already quite tight. The company has also expanded its capital expenditures and outsourcing to cope with the situation.

Lianya's second quarter financial report achieved a three-rate three-rise, with two consecutive quarters of good performance. As the demand for data centers continues to increase, Lianya stated that the demand for silicon light products remains extremely strong, and with the company's production capacity and downstream outsourcing factories continuing to rise, it is expected that silicon light product shipments will continue to increase in the next few quarters.

Lianya pointed out that the current CW Laser production capacity is already quite tight, and the outsourcing factory's production capacity is far from meeting the company's demand. It has been confirmed that some orders have been outsourced to external factories. Meanwhile, with the continuous construction of AI data centers, CW Laser has a significant advantage in the development of optical communication, which is also the reason why Lianya is still expanding its capital expenditures. The company's main production capacity is still focused on CW Laser.

In addition, Lianya also stated that, despite the global shortage of indium phosphide (InP) substrate, which is subject to Chinese regulations, Lianya has been in continuous contact with other suppliers, and the substrate shortage is not significant.

Lianya emphasized that in the future, data centers will transition from scale-out to optical communication, and will gradually extend to EML and receive end optical photodiodes (PD). EML and CW Laser have different application advantages and are not mutually exclusive or mutually exclusive. Different optical communication transmission also has its own advantages.

items.title: 美超微狂飆19% AI基礎建設股全面上漲
items.title_en: Supermicro Soars 19% as AI Infrastructure Stocks Rally Across the Board
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，AI基礎建設類股周三(12日)全面上漲，此前AI伺服器硬體製造商美超微電腦(Supermicro)(SMCI-US)及新興雲端服務商CoreWeave(CRWV-US)與Nebius(NBIS-US)公布亮眼財報。AI託管業者Applied Digital(APLD-US)與IREN(IREN-US)股價也走高。
美超微與CoreWeave周三大漲超過19%，Nebius更暴漲逾34%。
AI基礎建設交易的其他領域同樣上漲，包括光學產品製造商Lumentum(LITE-US)。記憶體及儲存類股也走強，Roundhill Memory ETF(DRAM-US)同步上漲。
從運算能力、AI伺服器機櫃到液冷技術，各項AI基礎建設的需求都顯示正在加速，隨著相關企業陸續公布財報，整個AI基礎建設產業因此全面走高。
Nebius股價飆升，此前公司公布的季營收高於分析師預期。美超微公布第四季財報，獲利遠超分析師預期，財測也樂觀。
新興雲端服務商及AI託管業者Applied Digital與IREN股價走高，因AI雲端服務商CoreWeave財報顯示需求正在加速，積壓訂單也大幅增加。
Lumentum股價上漲逾13%。這家為資料中心提供光學及光電產品的製造商公布第四季營收達10.1億美元，較去年同期增加超過一倍。同業Coherent(COHR-US)及Ciena(CIEN-US)股價也雙雙大漲。
記憶體及儲存類股同樣走高，Roundhill Memory ETF大漲7.6%，近期漲勢強勁的SanDisk(SNDK-US)則上漲5.7%。
記憶體製造商美光(MU-US)漲近5%，競爭對手SK海力士(SKHY-US)飆升9%。
隨著企業陸續採用AI，投資人一直在押注所謂的「賣鏟子」交易，也就是投資那些提供AI技術所需基礎建設的企業，而相關公司目前也持續預期市場需求強勁。
Fundstrat周三指出，在截至目前已公布財報的標普500指數企業中，87%的公司獲利優於預期，而這些「優於預期」的企業，其實際表現中位數比市場預期高出7%。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that AI infrastructure stocks rose across the board on Wednesday (the 12th) after AI server hardware maker Supermicro (SMCI-US) and emerging cloud service provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) along with Nebius (NBIS-US) posted impressive earnings. AI hosting firms Applied Digital (APLD-US) and IREN (IREN-US) also saw their shares climb.
Supermicro and CoreWeave surged more than 19% on Wednesday, while Nebius rocketed over 34%.

Other segments of AI infrastructure trading also rose, including optical‑product maker Lumentum (LITE-US). Memory and storage stocks were strong as well, with the Roundhill Memory ETF (DRAM-US) moving higher in tandem.

Demand for all facets of AI infrastructure—from compute power and AI server racks to liquid‑cooling technology—is accelerating, and as related companies continue to release earnings, the entire AI infrastructure sector is moving higher.
Nebius’s stock spiked after the company reported quarterly revenue that beat analysts’ expectations. Supermicro’s fourth‑quarter results came in far above forecasts, prompting an upbeat outlook.
Emerging cloud service and AI hosting firms Applied Digital and IREN saw their shares rise as CoreWeave’s earnings showed accelerating demand and a sharp increase in back‑logged orders.

Lumentum’s stock jumped more than 13%. The data‑center optical and photonic product maker reported fourth‑quarter revenue of $1.01 billion, more than double the same period last year. Peers Coherent (COHR-US) and Ciena (CIEN-US) also posted strong gains.
Memory and storage stocks also climbed, with the Roundhill Memory ETF up 7.6% and the recently strong‑performing SanDisk (SNDK-US) gaining 5.7%.
Memory chipmaker Micron (MU-US) rose nearly 5%, while rival SK Hynix (SKHY-US) surged 9%.

As enterprises increasingly adopt AI, investors have been betting on the so‑called “shovel‑seller” trade—investing in companies that provide the infrastructure needed for AI technologies—and those firms continue to expect robust market demand.

Fundstrat noted on Wednesday that among S&P 500 companies that have reported earnings to date, 87% posted profits that beat expectations, and the median actual performance of these “beat‑the‑estimate” firms was 7% above market forecasts.

items.title: 聯準會9月升不升息？債市仍押「五五波」 緊盯兩大關鍵數據
items.title_en: Will the Fed Raise Rates in September? Bond Market Still Bets on a “50‑50” Move, Watching Two Key Data Points
paras: 儘管美國通膨數據溫和，交易員仍維持對聯準會（Fed）可能在9月下次會議升息的避險部位，目前市場定價顯示，9月升息機率約為50%。
美國消費者物價指數（CPI）符合預期，帶動美國公債週三(12日)延續漲勢。對Fed政策變化最敏感的2年期美債殖利率下跌3個基點至4.18%；指標10年期美債殖利率同樣下滑3個基點至4.65%。市場並等待當天稍晚登場、規模420億美元的10年期美債標售。
利率交換市場顯示，在經濟數據公布後，交易員將10月升息機率由前一天約75%下調至約60%，而市場已完全反映Fed將在12月採取下一步行動的預期。
Aviva Investors資深固定收益投資組合經理Steve Ryder表示：「這份數據應能讓市場繼續保留9月升息的可能性，但也沒有讓Fed立即採取行動的迫切性。」
他指出，決策官員在決定今年稍晚是否需要進一步緊縮政策前，可能會更加重視下一份CPI與就業市場報告。
根據美國勞工統計局（BLS）數據，7月剔除波動較大的食品與能源項目後，核心CPI月增0.2%；年增率則為2.5%，創下自2021年3月以來的最慢增長步調。
這份通膨數據出爐前，上週公布的7月就業市場數據已低於預期。由於Fed下一次利率決策會議要到9月才舉行，市場焦點將轉向下一輪8月通膨與就業報告。
在此期間，債券投資人也將密切關注於懷俄明州傑克森霍爾（Jackson Hole）舉行的年度全球央行年會。
Natixis North America美國首席經濟學家Christopher Hodge表示，未來幾次Fed會議都必須納入意外升息的可能性，但該行仍認為，隨著通膨緩慢且逐步朝目標回落、消費部門降溫，加上就業前景更加脆弱，Fed最終仍可能驚險避免升息。
paras_en: Despite moderate U.S. inflation data, traders are still holding hedge positions for a possible Fed rate hike at the September meeting, with market pricing indicating roughly a 50% probability of a September hike.

The U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) came in line with expectations, pushing U.S. Treasury bonds higher on Wednesday (the 12th). The 2‑year Treasury yield, most sensitive to Fed policy changes, fell 3 basis points to 4.18%, while the benchmark 10‑year yield also slipped 3 basis points to 4.65%. The market is awaiting a later‑in‑the‑day $42 billion 10‑year Treasury auction.

The interest‑rate swap market showed that after the economic data release, traders cut the probability of a October hike from about 75% the day before to roughly 60%, and the market has fully priced in expectations that the Fed will take its next step in December.

Aviva Investors senior fixed‑income portfolio manager Steve Ryder said: “This data should allow the market to keep the possibility of a September hike alive, but it does not create an urgent need for the Fed to act immediately.”
He added that policymakers, before deciding whether further tightening is needed later this year, are likely to place even greater emphasis on the next CPI reading and the employment report.

According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, core CPI – which strips out the more volatile food and energy components – rose 0.2% month‑over‑month in July and 2.5% year‑over‑year, the slowest pace since March 2021.

Before this inflation data was released, last week’s July employment figures had already come in below expectations. Because the Fed’s next rate‑policy meeting isn’t until September, market focus will shift to the upcoming August inflation and jobs reports.
During that interim, bond investors will also be closely watching the annual global central‑bank gathering in Jackson Hole, Wyoming.

Natixis North America chief economist Christopher Hodge said that future Fed meetings must factor in the possibility of an unexpected rate hike, but the firm still believes that as inflation eases slowly toward target, consumer demand cools, and the employment outlook weakens, the Fed may ultimately manage to avoid another hike altogether.

items.title: iPhone 20 Pro傳螢幕再放大 以四曲面玻璃打造「無邊框」視覺
items.title_en: iPhone 20 Pro's Screen May Be Enlarged with a 'Borderless' Visual Effect Using Four-Curved Glass
paras: 蘋果傳為iPhone問世20週年籌備全新設計，預計iPhone 20 Pro系列可能維持既有螢幕長寬比例，同時放大顯示面積，並透過特殊曲面玻璃營造近乎「無邊框」的視覺效果。
微博爆料者「數碼閒聊站」週三表示，代號V73與V74的iPhone 20 Pro及iPhone 20 Pro Max，螢幕尺寸都將比前代稍大，但長寬比例不會明顯改變。
根據先前說法，蘋果 (AAPL-US)正在測試6.4吋與7吋兩種螢幕，分別用於iPhone 20 Pro和iPhone 20 Pro Max。相較之下，iPhone 17 Pro與Pro Max的螢幕尺寸分別為6.3吋及6.9吋，意味新機可能各增加0.1吋。
這套設計並非直接採用彎曲顯示面板。爆料指出，iPhone 20 Pro系列可能保留平面螢幕，再於外層覆蓋經過特殊塑形的四曲面玻璃，利用光學折射弱化螢幕邊界，形成四周幾乎看不見邊框的效果。
換言之，傳聞所稱的「無邊框」主要是由玻璃造型與光線折射營造的視覺效果，並不一定代表實體邊框完全消失。
類似消息先前已多次流出。「數碼閒聊站」7月便曾提到iPhone 20 Pro系列可能採用6.4吋及7吋螢幕，4月也曾透露蘋果考慮使用「四微曲」OLED面板。另一名微博爆料者「定焦數碼」近期則再度提及，新機可能大量運用玻璃材質，並借鑑iPhone Air的部分設計元素。
不過，iPhone 20 Pro距離正式亮相仍有一段時間，目前相關規格均未獲蘋果證實。微博爆料消息的準確度也不一，儘管「數碼閒聊站」過去擁有一定命中紀錄，現階段仍應視為市場傳聞。
這項爆料也與Jefferies分析師日前的說法形成對比。Jefferies認為，蘋果可能已因量產難度取消20週年全玻璃iPhone計畫，但近期多項供應鏈傳聞仍指向玻璃占比更高、四曲面及無邊框視覺等設計方向，顯示相關方案可能尚未完全遭到放棄。
paras_en: Apple is reportedly preparing a new design for the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, with the iPhone 20 Pro series expected to maintain the existing screen aspect ratio while increasing the display area, creating a near 'borderless' visual effect through special curved glass.

Weibo leaker 'Digital Chat Station' revealed on Wednesday that the iPhone 20 Pro and iPhone 20 Pro Max, codenamed V73 and V74, will have slightly larger screens than their predecessors, but the aspect ratio will not change significantly.

According to previous reports, Apple (AAPL-US) is testing 6.4-inch and 7-inch screens for the iPhone 20 Pro and iPhone 20 Pro Max, respectively. In comparison, the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max have screen sizes of 6.3 inches and 6.9 inches, indicating that the new devices may increase by 0.1 inches each.

This design does not directly use a curved display panel. The leak suggests that the iPhone 20 Pro series may retain a flat screen and cover it with specially shaped four-curved glass, using optical refraction to weaken the screen border and create an effect where the edges are almost invisible.
In other words, the so-called 'borderless' effect is mainly created by the glass shape and light refraction, and does not necessarily mean that the physical border will completely disappear.

Similar news has been leaked multiple times before. 'Digital Chat Station' mentioned in July that the iPhone 20 Pro series may use 6.4-inch and 7-inch screens, and in April, it was revealed that Apple was considering using 'four micro-curved' OLED panels. Another Weibo leaker, 'Digital Focus', recently mentioned that the new device may heavily use glass materials and borrow design elements from the iPhone Air.

However, the iPhone 20 Pro is still some time away from its official release, and the related specifications have not been confirmed by Apple. The accuracy of Weibo leaks is also inconsistent, although 'Digital Chat Station' has a certain track record, it should still be viewed as market rumors at this stage.

This leak also contradicts the statement made by Jefferies analyst recently. Jefferies believes that Apple may have canceled the all-glass iPhone plan for the 20th anniversary due to production difficulties, but recent supply chain rumors still point to a higher glass content, four-curved, and 'borderless' visual design, indicating that the plan may not have been completely abandoned.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元抹去CPI數據後跌幅 荷姆茲海峽局勢不明推升避險需求
paras: 美元周三(12日)從盤中低點反彈並小幅走升，中東和平協議的不確定性，抵銷了符合預期的7月消費者通膨數據所帶來的影響。最新通膨數據降低了市場對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期。
近期投資人提高對貨幣政策收緊的預期，帶動美元走強，但最新通膨數據並未出現足以延續這波漲勢的意外升幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報99.98。CPI數據早上公布後，美元指數一度擴大跌幅，觸及99.61盤中低點，之後回升並在中午前轉為走高。
外匯市場參與者周三將焦點集中在7月消費者物價指數(CPI)報告，以尋找更多貨幣政策前景的線索。上周五公布的7月就業報告弱於預期，導致市場迅速重新調整對聯準會9月升息的預期。
根據美國勞工統計局數據，7月整體CPI月增0.1%，6月則下跌0.4%。年增率則從6月的3.5%放緩至3.4%。扣除食品及能源價格的核心CPI，7月月增0.2%，6月則持平。年增率也從2.6%放緩至2.5%。上述4項數據均符合市場預期。
周四將接著公布7月生產者物價指數(PPI)。雖然CPI與PPI都是市場廣泛關注的通膨指標，但聯準會更偏好追蹤個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，以評估通膨情勢。CPI與PPI中的部分項目會被納入PCE的計算。
對聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)而言，這些符合預期的數據可能讓其有更多空間維持利率不變，而不是升息，尤其是在周五公布疲弱就業報告之後。
利率市場也反映出這項預期。CME FedWatch工具顯示，CPI公布後，市場預期9月維持利率不變的機率從54%升至62%。
荷姆茲海峽緊張持續 布油徘徊90美元
目光轉向中東，油價周三震盪，市場持續受到各方對荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)不同說法的影響。布蘭特原油(Brent)期貨一度短暫觸及每桶90美元。
目前看來，重新開放這條重要水道的和平協議進展有限，美國與伊朗仍持續宣稱掌握這條重要航道的控制權。
美國總統川普在Truth Social上表示，「美國完全控制荷姆茲海峽。」
伊朗國營媒體周二稍早報導，伊朗再次提出要求，表示美國必須停止各條戰線上的敵對行動，並解凍遭凍結的資產，荷姆茲海峽才會重新開放。相關說法引述伊朗國家安全委員會主席Mohsen Rezaei向中國駐德黑蘭大使發表的言論。
據伊朗國營媒體，Rezaei表示，「在美國改變行為並接受伊朗的條件之前，荷姆茲海峽不會開放。任何伊朗與阿曼之間的航運協議，都是獨立於荷姆茲海峽關閉之外的另一件事。」
Kpler數據顯示，周二獲確認通過荷姆茲海峽的船隻數量小幅增加，但整體市場氣氛仍保持謹慎，加上新的攻擊事件進一步加劇擔憂。
葉門叛軍「青年運動」(Houthi)在曼德海峽(Mandeb Strait)攻擊商業航運，造成4名貨輪船員及2名葉門救援人員死亡。
日元持續回吐干預後漲幅
其他主要貨幣方面，日元兌美元走弱，持續回吐上月底華盛頓與東京進行歷史性聯合干預後取得漲幅。美元兌日元上漲0.1%，至159.46。

items.title: 歐洲迎來百年首見日全食！飯店房價一晚飆破千美元
items.title_en: Europe Sees Rare Total Solar Eclipse, Hotel Prices Soar Past $1,000 per Night
paras: 歐洲罕見日全食週三 (12 日) 登場，觀測帶橫跨冰島、格陵蘭、英國、葡萄牙及西班牙北部，帶動旅遊需求短時間暴增。冰島首都雷克雅維克與西班牙畢爾包等熱門觀測城市，飯店及短期租屋價格一度突破每晚 1,000 美元 (約新台幣 3.23 萬元)。
旅宿數據公司 Lighthouse Intelligence 於 7 月中旬、距離日食約一個月時調查發現，雷克雅維克日食當週的飯店平均房價達每晚 1,012 美元 (約新台幣 3.26 萬元)，較去年同期增加一倍；短期租屋均價更升至 1,172 美元 (約新台幣 3.78 萬元)，年增 178%。
西班牙北部同樣出現明顯漲勢。畢爾包短期租屋均價攀至每晚 1,088 美元 (約新台幣 3.51 萬元)，較去年同期大漲 206%；飯店均價則上漲 35%，來到 315 美元 (約新台幣 1.02 萬元)。位於日全食帶外圍的聖地牙哥－德孔波斯特拉相對便宜，飯店均價為 193 美元 (約新台幣 6,224 元)，年增 13%。
Lighthouse 內容行銷主管 Jonathan Gough 表示，面對世界盃或泰勒絲演唱會等「一生難得一遇」的大型活動，旅館業者通常會測試市場能夠承受的最高價格，這次日全食也不例外。
不過，冰島旅館業者最初採取的高價策略並未完全奏效。最新數據顯示，截至 8 月 10 日，雷克雅維克與首都周邊地區 8 月 12 日最低可訂房價，已較 5 月中旬分別下調 46%與 51%，降至 805 美元 (約新台幣 2.60 萬元)及 793 美元 (約新台幣 2.56 萬元)，反映業者在活動前夕加大折扣以消化空房。
Gough 指出，冰島業者早在一年多前便以正常房價的三至四倍試水溫，但近三個月持續調降價格；西班牙北部業者則採取相反策略，春季仍維持一般價格，隨著訂房量增加才逐步漲價。
即使部分地區價格回落，日食當天的住宿需求仍相當強勁。西班牙拉科魯尼亞的需求已達平日五倍以上，在房間供給有限的情況下，價格成為旅客能否入住的主要門檻。
短期租屋市場也明顯受惠。AirDNA 數據顯示，冰島約 9,000 間可出租房源中，接近 64%位於日全食帶內；西班牙約 36.54 萬間房源中，也有約 21%位於觀測路徑範圍。
冰島日全食帶內的短租需求較去年同期增加 40%，高於其他地區的 13.2%。西班牙今年夏季氣溫一度超過華氏 104 度 (約攝氏 40 度)，8 月 11 日至 12 日晚間，日食帶內短租需求年減 1.6%，但跌幅仍小於其他地區的 9.1%，顯示日全食在一定程度上抵銷極端高溫對旅遊市場的衝擊。
Gough 認為，這場天文奇景確實為歐洲部分地區帶來強勁但高度集中的觀光效益，住宿熱潮可能只維持一至兩晚，難以改變整個旅遊旺季。相較之下，熱浪及極端天氣正在改變歐洲人的夏季旅遊選擇，對觀光業造成的影響可望比日全食更加長遠。
paras_en: A rare total solar eclipse is set to appear in Europe on Wednesday (12th), with the observation path spanning across Iceland, Greenland, the UK, Portugal, and northern Spain, leading to a surge in tourism demand. Reykjavik, the capital of Iceland, and Bilbao, Spain, among other popular observation cities, saw hotel and short-term rental prices skyrocket to over $1,000 per night.

According to data from Lighthouse Intelligence, which surveyed in mid-July, about a month before the eclipse, Reykjavik's average hotel price for the eclipse week reached $1,012 per night, a 100% increase from the same period last year. Short-term rental prices averaged $1,172 per night, a 178% increase from the previous year.

The northern region of Spain also saw a significant price hike. Bilbao's short-term rental prices soared to $1,088 per night, a 206% increase from the same period last year, while hotel prices rose 35% to $315 per night. Santiago de Compostela, located on the periphery of the eclipse path, was relatively more affordable, with hotel prices averaging $193 per night, a 13% increase from the previous year.

Lighthouse's content marketing manager, Jonathan Gough, explained that hotel operators typically test the market's ability to bear the highest prices during large events like the World Cup or Taylor Swift concerts. This time, the total solar eclipse was no exception.

However, Icelandic hotel operators' initial high-price strategy did not entirely pay off. Latest data shows that, as of August 10, Reykjavik and the surrounding area's lowest available hotel prices for August 12 had dropped by 46% and 51%, respectively, from mid-May, to $805 and $793 per night, reflecting operators' efforts to clear inventory by offering discounts before the event.

Gough noted that Icelandic operators had been testing the market with prices three to four times the normal rate over a year and a half ago, but had been continuously reducing prices over the past three months. Spanish operators in the north, on the other hand, had maintained normal prices during the spring and only began to raise them as bookings increased.

Even as prices fell in some areas, demand for accommodations remained strong on the day of the eclipse. In La Coruña, Spain, demand was over five times the usual level, with prices becoming the main barrier to entry in a market with limited supply.

The short-term rental market also benefited significantly. AirDNA data showed that about 64% of the approximately 9,000 available rentals in Iceland were located within the eclipse path, while about 21% of the approximately 365,400 rentals in Spain were within the observation path.

Short-term rental demand in Iceland's eclipse path increased by 40% compared to the same period last year, outpacing the 13.2% increase in other areas. In Spain, demand for short-term rentals in the eclipse path decreased by 1.6% from last year, but was still lower than the 9.1% decline in other areas, indicating that the eclipse had some mitigating effect on the impact of extreme heat on the tourism market.

Gough believes that this celestial event has brought strong but highly concentrated tourism benefits to certain European regions, with the accommodation boom likely to last only one to two nights and not significantly altering the overall tourism season. In contrast, heatwaves and extreme weather are changing Europeans' summer travel choices, potentially having a more lasting impact on the tourism industry.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉溫和CPI消除升息疑慮 費半強漲近2.5% 記憶體類股噴高
items.title_en: Soft CPI Eases Rate Hike Concerns, Semis Surge 2.5%, Memory Stocks Soar
paras: 美國7月通膨略為降溫，強化聯準會9月維持利率不變的預期，加上AI基礎設施及記憶體類股強勢上漲，美股週三 (12 日) 多收高。費半指數勁揚近 2.5%，那斯達克指數上漲0.54%，標普500指數漲0.26%，道瓊指數幾乎收在平盤。
美國7月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 年增3.4%，符合市場預期，低於6月的3.5%；月增率則為0.1%。通膨持續降溫後，交易員轉而押注聯準會9月將按兵不動，扭轉前一日升息與維持利率不變機率約各半的局面。
不過，美國通膨率仍高於聯準會2%目標，加上中東局勢持續推高能源價格及美債殖利率，使聯準會官員對是否升息仍存在分歧。
美國與伊朗就重新開放荷姆茲海峽的談判持續陷入僵局。美方週二對一艘試圖穿越阿曼灣、懸掛巴拿馬國旗的船隻開火，進一步加劇市場對原油供應的擔憂，布蘭特原油期貨一度逼近每桶90美元。
油價上漲也推高美國汽油價格。全美普通汽油平均價格週三升至每加侖4.03美元，較一個月前上漲約0.16美元，創歷年8月中旬同期新高。
美股週三 (12 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭盡墨。Meta (META-US) 下跌 3.38%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.87%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 微跌 0.08%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.26%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 1.83%。
費城半導體族群多收紅。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 1.82%；博通 (AVGO-US) 微跌 0.01%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 3.03%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 大漲 4.29%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 0.24%。
記憶體與儲存類股同步走高。美光科技 (MU-US) 大漲 4.92%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 上漲 3.69%；閃迪 (SNDK-US) 勁揚 5.76%；希捷科技 (STX-US) 大漲 7.03%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 狂飆 9.01%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.68%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 1.63%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.95%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 微跌 0.12%。
企業新聞
溫蒂漢堡 (WEN-US) 瘋漲14.70%至每股 8.66 美元，英國《金融時報》引述消息人士報導，億萬富豪投資人Nelson Peltz 旗下 Trian Fund Management 正準備提出收購要約，計劃將溫蒂漢堡私有化。
全球AI伺服器大廠美超微 (SMCI-US) 暴漲19.02%至每股 37.61 美元，其第四季業績優於預期，同時發布樂觀的第一季財測，顯示 AI 伺服器需求仍然穩健。
AI 雲端運算公司CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 猛升 19.28% 至每股 107.73 美元，公司第二季調整後營業利益率達 5%，優於市場預期，營收較去年同期成長逾一倍。
Nebius Group (NBIS-US) 週三漲幅高逾34% 至每股 259.20 美元。這家 AI 基礎設施公司公布的稅前息前折舊攤銷前獲利 (EBITDA) 與營收均優於 FactSet 調查的分析師預期，毛利率表現也超出市場預估。
Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US) 大幅走高13.63%至每股 932.47 美元，該公司調整後每股盈餘及營收雙雙優於市場預期。受惠於 AI 熱潮，Lumentum股價今年迄今已上漲超過一倍。
華爾街分析
CPI 公布後，市場對聯準會 9 月按兵不動的預期升溫。
摩根士丹利財富管理首席經濟策略師 Ellen Zentner 表示，符合預期的通膨數據，將延續上週就業報告公布後形成的「沒有升息必要」論述。9 月聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 會議前仍有一輪通膨數據，但除非數字呈現截然不同的走勢，聯準會下月仍可能維持利率不變。
(數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主)
paras_en: US July inflation eased, bolstering expectations for the Fed to keep rates steady in September, as AI infrastructure and memory stocks surged, driving US stocks higher on Wednesday (12). The S&P 500 index rose 0.26%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was little changed, and the Nasdaq Composite index rose 0.54%.

US July consumer price index (CPI) rose 3.4% year-over-year, in line with market expectations, and below June's 3.5%. The month-over-month rate was 0.1%. After inflation continued to ease, traders shifted their bets to a 50-50 chance of the Fed keeping rates steady in September, reversing the previous day's 50-50 chance of a rate hike.

However, US inflation remains above the Fed's 2% target, and the ongoing Middle East tensions continue to push up energy prices and US Treasury yields, leaving Fed officials divided on whether to raise rates.

US and Iran negotiations over reopening the Strait of Hormuz remain stalled. The US fired on a ship trying to cross the Gulf of Oman, carrying a Panamanian flag, on Tuesday, further exacerbating concerns over oil supply, with Brent crude futures briefly touching $90 per barrel.

Rising oil prices also pushed up US gasoline prices. The national average price of regular gasoline rose to $4.03 per gallon on Wednesday, up about 0.16 dollars from a month ago, a new high for the August mid-month period.
US stocks on Wednesday (12) showed the following performances:

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 21.58 points, or 0.04%, to 53,770.27. The Nasdaq Composite index rose 143.04 points, or 0.54%, to 26,588.49. The S&P 500 index rose 20.30 points, or 0.26%, to 7,748.50. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 300.90 points, or 2.49%, to 12,399.38. The NYSE FANG+ Index fell 104.74 points, or 0.56%, to 18,474.70.

The five tech giants in the NYSE FANG+ Index all fell. Meta (META-US) fell 3.38%. Apple (AAPL-US) fell 0.87%. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) fell 0.08%. Microsoft (MSFT-US) fell 2.26%. Amazon (AMZN-US) fell 1.83%.

The semiconductor group in Philadelphia rose strongly. AMD (AMD-US) rose 1.82%. Broadcom (AVGO-US) fell 0.01%. NVIDIA (NVDA-US) rose 3.03%. Applied Materials (AMAT-US) rose 4.29%. Qualcomm (QCOM-US) rose 0.24%.

Memory and storage stocks rose in sync. Micron Technology (MU-US) rose 4.92%. Western Digital (WDC-US) rose 3.69%. SanDisk (SNDK-US) rose 5.76%. Western Digital (STX-US) rose 7.03%. SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) rose 9.01%.

Taiwanese ADRs rose more than fell. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. ADR (TSM-US) rose 1.68%. ASML Holding ADR (ASX-US) rose 1.63%. United Microelectronics Corp. ADR (UMC-US) rose 1.95%. Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT-US) fell 0.12%.
Company news

Wendy's (WEN-US) surged 14.70% to $8.66 per share, after a report by the Financial Times cited a source saying that billionaire investor Nelson Peltz's Trian Fund Management is preparing a takeover bid, planning to take the company private.

Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) surged 19.02% to $37.61 per share, after the company reported better-than-expected fourth-quarter results and optimistic first-quarter guidance, showing that AI server demand remains robust.
CoreWeave (CRWV-US) surged 19.28% to $107.73 per share, after the company reported a second-quarter adjusted EBITDA of 5%, beating market expectations, and revenue growth of over 100% year-over-year.
Nebius Group (NBIS-US) surged more than 34% to $259.20 per share, after the company reported better-than-expected EBITDA and revenue, and a higher-than-expected gross margin.

Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US) surged 13.63% to $932.47 per share, after the company reported better-than-expected adjusted EPS and revenue. The company's stock has risen more than 100% this year, driven by the AI boom.
Wall Street analysis
After the CPI report, market expectations for the Fed to keep rates steady in September rose.

Morgan Stanley's chief economist Ellen Zentner said that the inflation data, which was in line with expectations, would continue the narrative that there is no need for a rate hike. There is still one more inflation report before the Fed's September meeting, but unless the numbers show a sharp change in direction, the Fed may keep rates steady next month.
